description_target.target_text: Red(2) emitters on the left border cast right beams. Blue(1) emitters on the top border cast down beams. Gray(5) cells block beams. Output only the cells reached by both kinds of beams, colored cyan(8), and keep the blockers.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (last-list xs) (if (empty? (rest xs)) (first xs) (last-list (rest xs))))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (flat grid) (apply append grid))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                           (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (list (list 0))
            (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
              (subgrid grid r0 c0 r1 c1)))))
    (define (component-grid obj)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))
                                  (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj))) 0)])
                ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
        (set-cell out (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (obj-color obj))))
    (define (binary-shape grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))
    (define (paste-crop grid shape top left)
      (for*/fold ([out grid])
                 ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                  [c (in-range (cols shape))])
        (let ((v (at shape r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (recolor-shape shape color)
      (grid-from-fn (rows shape) (cols shape)
        (lambda (r c) (if (= (at shape r c) 0) 0 color))))
    (define (rotate-times grid k)
      (cond [(= (modulo k 4) 0) grid]
            [(= (modulo k 4) 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= (modulo k 4) 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [else (rotate-ccw grid)]))
    (define (anti-diag-reflect grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid)
        (lambda (r c) (at grid (- (rows grid) 1 c) (- (rows grid) 1 r)))))
    (define (beamcast start dr dc blockers)
      (let loop ([r (+ (first start) dr)] [c (+ (second start) dc)] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(not (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))) acc]
              [(member? (list r c) blockers) acc]
              [else (loop (+ r dr) (+ c dc) (append acc (list (list r c))))])))
    (define (touches-border? cells grid)
      (any? (lambda (p)
              (or (= (first p) 0) (= (first p) (- (rows grid) 1))
                  (= (second p) 0) (= (second p) (- (cols grid) 1))))
            cells))
    (define (hole-regions grid)
      (filter (lambda (cells) (not (touches-border? cells grid))) (find-0-regions grid 0)))
    (define (shape-key grid) (append (list (rows grid) (cols grid)) (flat grid)))
    (define (lex-list< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) (not (empty? b))]
            [(empty? b) #f]
            [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [else (lex-list< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (shape< a b) (lex-list< (shape-key a) (shape-key b)))
    (define (unique-grids grids)
      (let loop ([remaining grids] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(empty? remaining) acc]
              [(any? (lambda (g2) (equal? g2 (first remaining))) acc) (loop (rest remaining) acc)]
              [else (loop (rest remaining) (append acc (list (first remaining))))])))
    (define (all-dihedral-forms shape)
      (let* ((r0 shape)
             (r1 (rotate-cw r0))
             (r2 (rotate-cw r1))
             (r3 (rotate-cw r2)))
        (unique-grids (list r0 (flip-lr r0) r1 (flip-lr r1) r2 (flip-lr r2) r3 (flip-lr r3)))))
    (define (canonical-dihedral shape)
      (first (sort (all-dihedral-forms shape) shape<)))
    (define (count-equal xs value)
      (length (filter (lambda (x) (equal? x value)) xs)))
    (define (gallery-bottom shapes)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows shapes)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols shapes)) (max 0 (- (length shapes) 1)))))
        (let loop ([remaining shapes] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((shape (first remaining)))
                (loop (rest remaining)
                      (+ left (cols shape) 1)
                      (paste-crop out shape (- h (rows shape)) left)))))))
    (define (gallery-top shapes)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows shapes)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols shapes)) (max 0 (- (length shapes) 1)))))
        (let loop ([remaining shapes] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((shape (first remaining)))
                (loop (rest remaining) (+ left (cols shape) 1) (paste-crop out shape 0 left)))))))
    (define (region-shape cells color)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0)) 0)])
                  ([p (in-list cells)])
          (set-cell out (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0) color))))
    (define (adjacent-colors grid cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
               (apply append
                      (map (lambda (p)
                             (filter values
                                     (map (lambda (d)
                                            (let ((rr (+ (first p) (first d))) (cc (+ (second p) (second d))))
                                              (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)) (at grid rr cc) #f)))
                                          cardinal-deltas)))
                           cells)))))
    (define (bfs-path start goal walls)
      (let ((prev (make-hash))
            (seen (make-hash)))
        (define (rebuild cur acc)
          (if (equal? cur #f) acc (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))
        (hash-set! prev start #f)
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (let bfs ([queue (list start)])
          (cond [(empty? queue) #f]
                [(equal? (first queue) goal) (rebuild goal (list))]
                [else
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (next-queue
                         (for/fold ([q (rest queue)])
                                   ([d (in-list (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list -1 0)))])
                           (let ((nr (+ (first cur) (first d))) (nc (+ (second cur) (second d))))
                             (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                                      (not (hash-has-key? seen (list nr nc)))
                                      (not (member? (list nr nc) walls))
                                      (or (= (at g nr nc) 0) (equal? (list nr nc) goal)))
                                 (begin
                                   (hash-set! seen (list nr nc) #t)
                                   (hash-set! prev (list nr nc) cur)
                                   (append q (list (list nr nc))))
                                 q)))))
                   (bfs next-queue))]))))

    (let* ((blockers (find-color g 5))
           (horiz (apply append
                         (map (lambda (r) (beamcast (list r 0) 0 1 blockers))
                              (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 2)) (range 0 (rows g))))))
           (vert (apply append
                        (map (lambda (c) (beamcast (list 0 c) 1 0 blockers))
                             (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 1)) (range 0 (cols g))))))
           (intersections (filter (lambda (p) (member? p vert)) horiz))
           (with-blockers (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) blockers 5)))
      (paint-cells with-blockers intersections 8))
  ))
